title: private-deployments-weekly-2026-09-07
summary: Weekly engineering update for Private Deployments (VPC / on-prem installs). Focus this week: unblock three active customer installs, finalize automated bootstrap for air-gapped clusters, and iterate on KMS/HSM integration guidance for customers.
standup_notes:

- Marcus: finished audit of installer logs for Acme Health; found TLS cert rotation bug causing post-install API failures. Patch in PR #512.
- Anika: ran two on-prem prechecks with FinFlow; found IAM role mapping mismatch with their IdP (Okta). Working with FinFlow SRE to update assertions.
- Priya: completed docs draft for KMS integration patterns (customer-facing). Seeking security review.

meeting_notes:

customer_blockers:
Active customer blockers this week:
- Acme Health: TLS cert rotation bug causes API server to reject connections after first cert renewal. Patch PR #512 created; needs QA and canary. Impact: production pre-go-live. Severity: high.
- FinFlow: SSO assertions include groups in unexpected claim field. Blocks automated role mapping; manual mapping workaround in place. Impact: delays RBAC validation. Severity: medium.
- Atlas Retail: no physical access to their air-gapped lab for final verification. Blocks completion of on-prem bootstrap and post-install tests. Impact: schedule slippage for 2-week on-site install. Severity: medium-high.
- Generic: customer KMS onboarding documentation incomplete for HSM-backed stores; several customers requested step-by-step examples for AWS CloudHSM and Azure Key Vault HSM.
